head: 1c3c5980
headSubject: feat(runtimehost): REG-245 -- Phase 4B, live runtime DDL for new bond-free concepts
summary: Shipped Phase 4C (REG-246): a REG-245-provisioned live concept is now fully REST-reachable through GeneratedConceptCrudController with no regenerate/rebuild/restart. Discovered ConceptGateway/JdbcBusinessConceptStore already resolve schema live from CompiledModel, so no live-appendable-map mechanism was needed -- a per-request resolveBinding falls through to the live model on a baked-map miss. Split the actual wiring into a new plain class (LiveConceptCrudSupport, runtimehost-core) since the mustache-templated controller cannot be unit-tested in isolation; the template itself shrank to a thin wrapper. Found and fixed a real bug during controller-level verification: create() never folded the generated id into its data map, breaking the very next getById. Two RED/GREEN proofs run (partial-merge semantics, and the id-in-data bug). Full run-runtimehost-gate.ps1 green (assembled sample app suite + runtimehost-core test task + coverage ratchet, which auto-raised honestly). check-dialect-sites/check-done-item-guards/check-doc-inventory all clean.
nextStep: Phase 4D (live-rebuildable UI manifest) is the last item in REG-244's original D1 Phase 3 plan: BusinessUiEmitter.manifestJson is a pure function of CompiledModel but lives in NPDevGenerator, a build-time-only module RuntimeHost never depends on at runtime -- porting its logic (or a subset) to a runtime-reachable module is real, undesigned work. Start the same way 4B/4C started: re-run Understand/Inspect against current code (line numbers drift), then EnterPlanMode before writing code. Independent alternatives needing no new design decision: Phase 6 (fresh exhaustive B28 residual sweep) or continuing Phase 5's QUAL-41 coverage programme.
verified: Full run-runtimehost-gate.ps1 via digest runner: BUILD SUCCESSFUL, assembled sample app's own suite green (incl. two new tests: LiveConceptCrudSupportTest's 3 cases at the runtimehost-core level, GeneratedConceptCrudControllerLiveConceptTest's 2 cases at the real-generated-controller level via standalone MockMvc), runtimehost-core's own test task green, coverage ratchet passed (honest re-measurement, not hand-edited). Both RED-proofs: (1) commented out the partial-merge in update(), reran narrowly, the 'partial update must not wipe other fields' assertion failed as expected, restored, reran green; (2) the id-in-data bug was caught live by the controller-level test (400 instead of 200 on getById immediately after create), fixed, reran green. check-dialect-sites.py: 0 sites outside the sanctioned package. check-done-item-guards.py: 0 blocking findings. check-doc-inventory.py: 0 blocking findings.
